page0.text:
I can't say for sure.
I'm sort of in Tohsaka's debt. And really, I just don't want to fight her in the first place.

page1.text:
"...No. I can't say for sure yet."
There still might be more even if we defeat the Master at school... There's that monster Berserker as well. We should work together for as long as we can."

page2.text:
"...I see. I will obey if my Master says so, but...that will only make it harder for you. Please do not regret your choice when the time comes."
Saber takes a bow and dismisses herself.

page3.text:
...
...Yeah, I know.
The more we cooperate, the greater the likelihood that there will be an inevitable fight in the end.

page4.text:
It'd be easier if I just got over this mental hurdle and considered her my enemy from the get-go.
Otherwise it'll cut deeper once we do part ways.
Because whether I win or Tohsaka wins, the survivor has to finish off the loser...
